name: Freshly reconnected account, one salary sighting: not credited, the mortgage is covered by a move (G359)

expected.notes: Re-derived for G360 with the pay on the 1st (calendar month) and the salary mid-period. Today is Thu 8 Oct 2026, payday Sun 1 Nov, 24 days away; the window is strictly before payday. The account was reconnected recently, so nothing is confirmed. Balances: Barclays 200 + Starling 2,000 = 2,200 pooled. The salary 3,000 expected Thu 15 Oct has a single sighting. A steady salary needs two, a reliable one three, so it is NOT credited to Barclays in any per-account walk. The mortgage 1,100 leaves Barclays on Fri 16 Oct. Left to spend is a pooled figure and the pool counts every expected income: 2,200, day 7 + 3,000 = 5,200, day 8 - 1,100 = 4,100, lowest point the opening 2,200, so Left to spend 2,200. Barclays walk (salary not credited): 200 - 1,100 = -900: after payments -900 and low point -900, so the verdict is short. At risk count is 1: the badge walks the account on its own balance and the mortgage (a commitment) takes it below zero (200 < 1,100). It counts the short walk, not the outcome; the cover move below is what resolves it. The cover plan sizes the move as the shortfall 900 rounded up to the next 5 (900) plus 10 = 910, taken from Starling, which can spare it (2,000, keeping at least 10). Spend from: Barclays is -900, shown as 0 (floored); Starling is 2,000 less the 910 its own live move card reserves = 1,090, under the pool of 2,200. The period is on day 8 (1 Oct is day 1), so there is no payday plan (companion.py:2558, days_into_period <= 3).
